isc_aggregation._note: Simplified model of SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) source aggregation, account correlation, the account delete threshold and source errors. Connector names are examples: check the ISC connector documentation for whether a given connector runs through a virtual appliance (VA) or as a SaaS connector.

connector_kinds.va: VA-based: the connector runs on a virtual appliance (VA) in a source cluster inside your network, so the VA cluster must be healthy before ISC can reach the system.
connector_kinds.saas: SaaS (direct): the connector runs in SailPoint's cloud and calls the application's API directly, with no virtual appliance.
connector_kinds.file: Flat file: there is no live connection; accounts arrive as a CSV file uploaded on the source's Import Data page (or through the API).

va_unreachable.label: virtual appliance unreachable
va_unreachable.where: Admin > Connections > Virtual Appliances: the source cluster and VA health (is the VA online and connected?); then the source's Import Data > Account Aggregation history

connection_failure.label: connection failure
connection_failure.where: the source's Test Connection and its health status on the Sources list; the Import Data > Account Aggregation history for the error; Search for the source's aggregation events

auth_failure.label: authentication failure
auth_failure.where: the source's connection settings: update the service account password or API token, then Test Connection; the Import Data history shows the failed run

file_invalid.label: invalid file
file_invalid.where: the source's Import Data > Account Aggregation: fix the CSV (header row, account ID column) and upload it again

unknown_error.label: unknown error
unknown_error.where: the source's Import Data > Account Aggregation history and health status, and Search for the source's aggregation events

concepts.aggregation: Reading the accounts (or entitlements) from a source into Identity Security Cloud so its account list matches the system.
concepts.correlation: Linking an aggregated account to the identity that owns it by comparing an account attribute with an identity attribute.
concepts.uncorrelated account: An account that no correlation rule could link to exactly one identity; it stays unowned until someone correlates it manually.
concepts.manual correlation: An administrator linking an account to an identity by hand; later aggregations keep that link.
concepts.optimized aggregation: An aggregation that only processes accounts that changed since the last run, so unchanged accounts are skipped.
concepts.account delete threshold: The percentage of a source's existing accounts that one aggregation may remove; above it the aggregation is cancelled and nothing is deleted.
concepts.entitlement aggregation: Reading the source's groups, roles and permissions into the entitlement catalog, separately from accounts.
concepts.virtual appliance: A SailPoint-supplied VM in your own network that runs connectors for systems the cloud cannot reach directly.

outcome_definitions.COMPLETED: The aggregation ran and its new, changed and removed accounts were applied.
outcome_definitions.ABORTED_DELETE_THRESHOLD: The aggregation would have removed more accounts than the delete threshold allows (or returned no accounts at all), so it was cancelled and nothing was deleted.
outcome_definitions.AGGREGATION_FAILED: The aggregation could not read the source; no account was added, changed or deleted.
outcome_definitions.CORRELATED: The account is linked to exactly one identity.
outcome_definitions.UNCORRELATED: No correlation rule matched an identity.
outcome_definitions.AMBIGUOUS: A correlation rule matched more than one identity, so the account is left uncorrelated and flagged for review.
